experiments.V16: PASS (corrected) — event-time order-flow, net EV +2.15 bps, CI [1.76, 2.60], p=0.0005, 6/6 regimes positive. Accounting: Net EV = mean(fill_prob * return) - mean(total_cost). Gross EV = mean(|return|) over trades only.

root_cause: V12-V15 failed because they used fixed-bar features, direction-only models, or fixed fill probabilities. V16 succeeds by (1) event-time features computed at each order-book event, (2) separate return-magnitude and fill-probability models with corrected fill target (queue thinning + high intensity + tight spread), (3) dynamic maker/taker execution routing based on expected P&L with conditional non-fill cost, (4) walk-forward validation. The key insight: order-flow signal exists but must be paired with realistic execution simulation to achieve positive net EV.
